name: Neon Raymarcher Shading Model
definition: A real-time raymarched shading model for a procedural neon city scene, computing diffuse, specular, ambient occlusion, metallic reflection, and emissive contributions per pixel.
summary: The Neon Raymarcher Shading Model is a real-time technique for procedural neon scenes that computes lighting per pixel, distinguished by its metalness-driven specular model and Fresnel-weighted metallic reflection term.
